_comment: Template, not a descriptor. The empty fields are ceremony outputs and must
not be invented: appId and quorumKeyId come from `tvc app create`,
securityDomainId is a fresh random 32 bytes per spec.md, and the two
digests come from the image build. Copy this to keyholder-v1.deployment.json
once they exist -- preflight only scans *.deployment.json, so this file is
qosVersion must stay equal to the qos_core pin in ../Cargo.toml; preflight
